table: SC-2304-C001是6V 3.0KG串口总线舵机，采用铝壳，钢齿轮箱、空芯杯电机、飞特自主研发的TTL控制板，高品质电位器，25T型输出头。堵转扭矩3.0kg.cm，有效控制角度为270±5°，具有伺服模式和连续转电机工作模式，反馈位置、速度、电压、温度、负载参数，从而实现过载保护。适合应用于教学、创客、机器人关节等小扭力传动应用场景。 SC-2304-C001 is a 6V 3.0kg serial bus servo. It features an aluminum housing, steel gearbox, coreless motor, FEETECH self-developed TTL control board, high-precision potentiometer and 25T output spline. It delivers a stall torque of 3.0kg·cm with an effective rotation angle of 270±5°. Supporting both servo mode and continuous rotation motor mode, it feeds back position, speed, voltage, temperature and load data to realize overload protection. It is ideal for low-torque transmission scenarios including STEM education, maker projects and robot joints.
